title: Prepare for Belgium's e-invoicing requirements
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Built for Belgium's Decentralized CTC Model


The pressure is continuity: one connection that carries invoices today and VAT data tomorrow. Belgium extends Peppol as the national standard, moving from interoperability to a decentralised continuous transaction control exchange model, so businesses that build once avoid rebuilding at every stage.


Vertex enables your organization to:


###


Exchange structured invoices over Peppol without manual reformatting.


###


Report VAT data to FPS Finance from the same connection.


###


Extend cross-border intra-EU invoicing without new tooling.


###


Keep validation consistent as scope widens toward 2030.
